title: onboard-spectra-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Ethan Brooks
commits: Initial model metadata and perf profiles for spectra-13b v1.0
Add quantization/fixture matrix and CPU/GPU throughput numbers
Wire changelog generation hook and update registry index
Fix validation errors in metadata schema and update docs
description: Onboard new open model 'spectra-13b v1.0' with full metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog entries. Motivation: spectra-13b is a high-throughput 13B variant that provides a cost/speed point between existing 7B and 14B families; making it available in the registry enables customers and the serving runtime to pick an optimal tradeoff. Changes: 1) model metadata YAML under models/spectra/13b/v1.0 including canonical name, aliases, tokenizer spec, supported sequence lengths, recommended batch sizes, and quantization compatibility flags; 2) performance profiles (cpu/gpu/quantized) generated from perf-lab runs and added to perf_profiles/*.json; 3) registry index update to expose the model in the catalog; 4) changelog automation hook: a small script that appends an entry to CHANGELOG.md for model onboards and emits machine-readable metadata for downstream release-notes generation. Checklist: - [x] Metadata conforms to schema (model-metadata.schema.json) - [x] Performance profiles validated against perf-harness (throughput + latency metrics) - [x] Changelog entry generated and reviewed - [x] CI passes (lint/unit/integration) - [x] Reviewed by infra and model-onboarding owners Notes: Perf numbers were produced by perf-canary runs on p4d and a4g instances; we include both fp16 and int8 quantized profiles. The changelog hook is intentionally small and idempotent; it will be used by our release automation to create release notes when models are promoted. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and QA steps.
review_comments: Priya Shah: Can you confirm the tokenizer spec is compatible with the tokenization service? I see a custom special_tokens setup.
Author (Ethan Brooks): Confirmed. Tokenizer matches the 'byte-level' config used by the tokenization service; added explicit alias mapping in metadata.yaml to avoid runtime mismatches.
Miguel Alvarez: Perf numbers look good but add percentile latency (p95) to GPU profiles for SLO assessment.
Author: Added p50/p95/p99 fields to the gpu_fp16 and gpu_int8 profile files and reran validation.
Chen Li: Small nits on schema validation—model-metadata.schema.json rejected the 'recommended_batch' as integer. Fixed schema to accept numbers or 'auto'.
Priya Shah: Approved after the latency fields and tokenizer alias fix.
release_notes: Added model: spectra-13b v1.0 — new 13B model with fp16 and int8 performance profiles; recommended batch/sequence guidance included. Changelog entry auto-generated for release pipeline.
